current_protocol_refresh.operation: GET only; no official submissions or code changes
current_protocol_refresh.current_description:
#### **赛题概述**
参考昇腾版本内置PadV3Grad算子的 TBE 实现，在昇腾 NPU 上基于 Ascend C 编程语言实现功能一致的算子, 完成算子设计、开发、测试全流程工作。
##### **功能实现要求**
与原 TBE 算子核心功能完全对齐，支持原算子对应的所有数据类型、数据格式，并且比较方式从二进制比较改为逻辑值比较。
必须实现算子泛化功能，满足各类合法输入场景的计算需求。
##### **测试标准**
需参考内置 TBE 算子自行设计全场景自验证用例，测试阶段将采用泛化数据进行功能、精度、性能全维度验证，所有测试用例执行通过。
##### **精度要求**
算子计算精度需满足 CANN Judge平台对应题目精度默认阈值（float : 1e-4, half : 1e-3, int类型:0）。
##### **问题答疑**
相关技术问题请到对应开源仓提交issue：[https://gitcode.com/cann/ops-math/issues](https://gitcode.com/cann/ops-math/issues)

bounded_comparison.definition: Compare the server-returned official total scores for precisely identified valid submissions at their recorded observation times, under the verified public scoring protocol. This is not a claim of constant hidden TBest or stable speedup.
required_checks: Exact problem_id and recoverable seven editable sources with all 38-file/template identity
Official terminal status Pass and valid=true, judge_revision and public_only/total/missing-case flags recorded
Current public protocol/config consistency; any known change is recorded and comparison limited accordingly
Exact submission_id-bound official ranking score and source/observation time; preserve every repeated observation
Public testcase identities and full numeric TBest when available; missing or rounded display precision must be explicit
acceptable_unknowns_not_preconditions: Hidden inputs and hidden per-case times/TBest values
Backend implementation details and undisclosed warmup/synchronization/aggregation/hardware-load data
Undisclosed degradation threshold; do not invent one
allowed_conclusions: Raw official score and arithmetic score difference with exact tasks and times
Ranking of the recorded observations only
Retention/prioritization recommendation qualified by separate correctness and stability gates
disallowed_conclusions: Derive an operator speedup or hidden metrics from total score
Claim unchanged hidden scale, fixed backend timing, statistical significance or stable causal improvement
Treat official Pass alone as proof of all legal input boundaries or approve the central baseline
bounded_comparison.dynamic_tbest_handling: Same public TBest values support observed consistency only. No visible drift is not proof of hidden immutability; the official dynamic-score comparison remains bounded to its observation timestamps.
bounded_comparison.historical_reuse: Reuse a fully identified prior official task when its required evidence is adequate; keep original round_id/task_id/experiment_id and do not count a read as a new run.
bounded_comparison.B_existing_record_gap: The supplied B rendered archive does not independently establish valid/judge_revision and only carries displayed TBest precision. Parent run audit decides exact usable records. A own authorized replay is a finite way to fill these concrete missing official fields, without B credentials.
bounded_comparison.four_arm_scope: A formal F/L/P/PL comparison requires the same evidence checks for all four arms. If only P/PL qualify, report that pair and leave the four-arm combination conclusion pending; old F/L scores cannot fill it by assumption.

C_numeric_gate.source_readme_note: Fixed C commit has no operators/Q06/round-001/C/README.md (git show and ls-tree checked); artifacts/tests/README.md is present and was read/exported.
C_numeric_gate.defect: The wrapper replaces ml_dtypes.bfloat16 with np.dtype(float32) when absent from sys.modules. The unmodified official reference compares x.dtype against bfloat16, so a float32 input is sent through torch.bfloat16 conversion; this changes reference execution and input values before float64 accumulation.
C_numeric_gate.secondary_defect: The wrapper hardcodes official_zero=0.0 and derives official_reference_output/candidate_abs_error from it instead of taking the recorded official output. Four reference_runs do record zero for that altered-dependency run, but this does not validate the intended dependency path.
C_numeric_gate.inference_limit: This static defect does not prove the real-dependency reference output differs, and it does not prove r6 fails on NPU.
